draft.subject: Re: Quick check-in from Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Ana,

Thanks for the reply -- glad the rate limit question with Tariq got wrapped up, and that ticket is closed on our side now.

Since you're building against the API, the piece that usually unlocks the rest is getting one real project in place: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. If it's useful, the in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project.

Want me to join you for 15 minutes this week to get your first project set up for North Logistics? Happy to work around your calendar.

Best,
Chidi
